name: Cache Cleaner – Smart Cache Control
author: Lumiverse Dynamic

sections.description:
You change something on your website, refresh the page, and the old version is still there. Usually, cache is doing its job a little too well.

Cache Cleaner gives you one place to see the cache tools it can find and refresh them when you need to.

Use Smart Purge for a normal refresh, Purge + Warm when you want important pages prepared again, or let Cache Cleaner handle selected changes automatically.

The dashboard also keeps a short activity history and shows simple health and activity information, so you can see what happened without digging through logs.

There is no Pro version. Everything is included.

Highlights

  • Automatically finds many popular WordPress cache tools
  • Smart Purge for normal day-to-day cache refreshes
  • Purge + Warm to prepare important pages again
  • Optional automatic refresh after content or software changes
  • Daily, weekly or monthly scheduled maintenance
  • A clear activity timeline and simple cache health view
  • Optional email after scheduled maintenance
  • Quick controls from the WordPress admin bar
  • No Lumiverse account and no telemetry

Cache Cleaner works with many popular cache plugins and hosting cache layers, including LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP Fastest Cache, Autoptimize, WP-Optimize, Cache Enabler, Breeze, Hummingbird, SiteGround Speed Optimizer, Nginx Helper and others.

Persistent object caches are handled more carefully and are not emptied by a normal Smart Purge.

Private by design

Cache Cleaner does not send your site URLs, settings or usage data to Lumiverse Dynamic.

When page warming is used, the plugin only visits selected public pages on your own website.

Made by Lumiverse Dynamic

Cache Cleaner is a free WordPress utility by Lumiverse Dynamic.

More information: https://lumiverse.gr/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Cache Cleaner.
  2. Open Cache Cleaner in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Check the cache layers it found.
  4. Choose the automatic options you want, if any.
  5. You are ready.

Updating from an older Cache Cleaner version? Your existing schedule and selected cache plugins are carried forward automatically.
sections.faq:
Will the new version change my old settings?

No. Older Cache Cleaner settings are carried forward carefully, and the old options are kept in place for rollback safety.

New automatic features stay off on upgraded sites until you choose to enable them.

What is Smart Purge?

It refreshes the cache layers you have allowed Cache Cleaner to manage, while avoiding more aggressive cache clearing unless you specifically ask for it.

What does Purge + Warm do?

After the cache refresh, Cache Cleaner visits a small set of important public pages so they can be cached again before a real visitor arrives.

Why is object cache protected?

Because emptying it is usually unnecessary for a normal website change and can temporarily make WordPress work harder. You can still allow it for a Full Purge from the advanced controls.

Does Cache Cleaner send data to Lumiverse?

No. There is no telemetry and no Lumiverse account is required.

I do not see my cache plugin. What can I do?

Tell us which cache plugin or hosting platform you use in the WordPress.org support forum. We can review it for a future update.
